issues: Lack of a distinct design language; the page feels like a well-executed but generic template.
The 'WriteFlow vs. The Competition' section is poorly designed, lacking visual hierarchy and a proper table structure.
The 'AI Suggestion' modal in the hero section is clunky and detracts from the main message, appearing as a generic pop-up.
strengths: Good use of whitespace and clear separation between different content sections.
All data elements (charts, pricing, testimonials) are populated with realistic content, avoiding placeholder states.
Consistent dark theme with appropriate accent color usage throughout the page.
specific_improvements: Redesign the 'WriteFlow vs. The Competition' section into a proper comparison table with clear columns, visual indicators (e.g., checkmarks), and better readability.
Introduce a distinct display font for headings to add more character and visual interest, moving beyond a single sans-serif family.
Replace the generic 'AI Suggestion' modal in the hero with a more integrated, polished product screenshot or a subtle animation that showcases the feature seamlessly.
